assets.prompt: Create a faithful transparent-background cutout asset of the SAME anime MengLi child in the supplied reference. Preserve the exact youthful androgynous child, white hair with pale blue shading, blue eyes, cat ears, face expression, oversized pale hoodie with little animal motifs, white socks and sneakers, full seated pose, left hand resting on seat and right arm pointing upward and to the right. Keep all body parts and clothes visible, entirely within image. Preserve original beautiful soft painterly anime rendering and proportions; do not age up or sexualize. Isolate only the character, remove ALL galaxy, stars, nebula, architecture and glass blocks. Transparent background throughout with clean soft antialiasing, no text, no extra glow, no new background. This will be placed lower-left of a dark astronomical telemetry display, pointing at the nebula to the upper-right. Output tall PNG cutout.

Create a transparent-background isolated astronomical nebula sprite for an elegant dark scientific dashboard. Use supplied reference ONLY as art direction for rich cyan teal blue violet cloud colours and a small warm white luminous heart. No text, NO interface lines, NO borders, NO stars, NO planet, NO person. The isolated nebula should be asymmetric and organic, wispy translucent volumetric gas, dramatic deep blue/teal veil and violet/magenta upper curls, warm pale ivory luminous central knot and narrow dark dust lanes, photographed astronomical cloud texture with fine filaments, subtle chromatic diffraction. Rich visible colours while mostly delicate transparent wisps. Irregular vertical-diagonal silhouette with some reaching tendrils, not a circular cloud, no rings, no disk, no spherical ball. Occupy central 70 percent of square canvas, large generous fully transparent margins, all wisps fade into complete alpha transparency. Output a beautiful high quality PNG sprite on alpha.

heel_underpaint.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Asset type: hidden-surface repair layer for a 2D character rig, NOT a redesigned character. Edit target: supplied 1024x1536 transparent original. Keep the same canvas and exact positions, scale, anime rendering, and lighting. Remove ONLY the foreground/near leg below mid-calf and its sneaker (the lower-left sneaker, approximately x580..855,y1160..1510). Reconstruct the previously hidden LEFT/BACK HEEL and sole of the farther/right sneaker behind it, so the right sneaker is complete with a rounded intact back heel rather than a diagonally cut missing corner. Keep the far/right sock and sneaker in exactly the original position (approximately x775..1010,y1230..1435), do not move or rescale them. The new heel should extend naturally behind where the foreground sneaker used to overlap, with the same pale lilac/white material and rubber sole; complete the entire heel contour. Preserve all other visible pixels and the original child, hands, clothes, upper legs, head and pose as faithfully as possible. No background, no shadow backdrop, no text. True transparent background. This image will only supply a tiny hidden heel patch behind the untouched original foreground art; exact same framing and far shoe alignment are essential.
